questions.stem: The patient, a 45-year-old man, has been experiencing recurrent falls and dizziness for six weeks. He has no personal or family history of chronic illnesses and is exposed to industrial solvents at work. During the examination, he displays an unsteady gait, inability to stand with feet together, and tremors in his hands while gripping a pen. Despite normal muscle strength and sensation, his ability for rapid hand movements is impaired. His mental status examination shows no abnormalities. What is the blood supply to the affected structure in this case?
